title: Credit & Debit Notes
notes: Rebuilt both list pages onto the ListPage archetype (PageHeader+count, FilterBar, DataTable w/ hover Apply action, useInfiniteScroll, detail drawer, EmptyState with create CTA, skeleton, bulk-apply selection, full-dataset CSV export). Built new create pages for both (RelationCombobox for invoice, line items with qty/rate/tax, ?invoiceId= prefill). Debit-notes still imports the CreditNote type alias (pre-existing #79, not in scope). No PhoneInput/AddressAutocomplete/CurrencyInput/DatePicker/SendMessageDialog fields — the note entity has none of those field types. No detail *page* exists (only the drawer) since the manifest didn't list one and hover Eye action was replaced by row click to open the drawer.
showcaseScript: Open Credit Notes and review outstanding balances
Issue a credit note against a paid invoice
Apply the credit note and watch the invoice balance drop
Switch to Debit Notes and issue one
